summary: Created and restart-verified the inventorysvc system account on node1.
actions_performed: Created inventorysvc with system UID 967 and a locked password.
Set /var/lib/inventory as its home directory, owned by inventorysvc:inventorysvc with mode 700.
Set /usr/bin/nologin as its shell and confirmed an interactive login attempt is rejected.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified full recovery and persistence.

evidence.summary: The account was created successfully; UID 967 is within the configured system UID range 500–999 and persisted after restart.
The passwd entry names /var/lib/inventory, and the directory exists with inventorysvc ownership before and after restart.
The shell is /usr/bin/nologin, the password is locked, and direct login attempts fail before and after restart.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 7902f335-6ba2-4a0b-8a98-8c5134484639, received safe reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot ID 4331c31c-b685-4066-b205-a040384624d1, and verified system health plus persistent account, home, and login restrictions.
